title: DESI 5-fold cross-validation reproducibility gate (mean pairwise Jaccard 0.862)

environment.hardware: cpu-only (5-fold BigAE proxy training over 47,000-row pool)

reproduction.notes: Each of the 5 proxy models trains on 4 folds and scores the full 47,000-row pool; pairwise top-1% Jaccard measures fold-model ranking stability. This is a ranking-stability gate over the training pool, not a fully out-of-sample re-score of the released 195,829-row catalog (per held_out_rescore.py's own framing).

verification: Re-run and confirm mean pairwise Jaccard >= 0.70 gate (committed value 0.8625) with 464/546 objects appearing in >=3 of 5 fold-model top-1% lists (consensus_fraction_of_union=0.8498), within a small numeric tolerance (<=0.02 absolute on mean Jaccard given training-seed variance).
